title: docs(plugin-view): teach the spec-shaped named list view — README `:154`, `plugin-view.mdx:72`, `schema-reference.md:863-864` currently teach the local dialect (label-only view, tuple filter, `default: true`) (docs half of #7928)
body:
Filed by the director seat under the #7928 ruling (decision batch #70, 2026-09-07, option A). #7928 is `pm:blocked` on this card and on the renderer card.

## Why

Three published documents teach `listViews` entries the spec's `ObjectListViewSchema` refuses: `packages/plugin-view/README.md:154` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx:72` (a label-only view with no `columns`), `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md:863-864` (an ObjectQL tuple filter `[["owner", "=", "…"]]` and `default: true`). Once the mirror is by reference, these examples fail validation.

## Scope

- Rewrite the three examples in the spec shape (`columns` present, spec filter syntax, no `default` unless the spec declares it); keep them as the docs gates compile them.
- Land after (or with) the renderer card, so the docs never teach a shape the renderer does not yet honour.
- `skip-changeset` (docs only).

## Acceptance

- [ ] all three examples validate against `ObjectListViewSchema`
- [ ] docs gates green
- [ ] #7928 notified

Refs #7928, #7923 (the schema-reference defect measured alongside).
